decisions.reason: The encrypted secondary channel builds directly on the firm's core cryptography and secure communication knowledge, so it can be maintained and improved, although it was only ever mentioned and never given a page of its own.

The multi-layer end-to-end security architecture is central to the firm's accumulated security expertise and was promoted to its own page in 2019, which signals that management could read its early results and chose to invest in it.

The QR-code hardware signature token got its own page and draws on the firm's signature and authentication know-how, unlike the dropped mobile PDF signature function, though hardware adds learning risk outside pure software.

The payment network compliance suite applies the firm's security knowledge to the regulated payment domain, where steady demand exists, but its low website prominence suggests weaker absorption and a moderate chance of being cut.
